name: com.showcasia/property-search
title: Showcasia property search
description: Search live property listings in Indian cities on Showcasia, with each listing's dated check status.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find live property listings on Showcasia (India) by city, section, locality, bedrooms and property type. Returns the public summary of each listing (type, bedrooms, locality, city) with a link to cite. Prices, photos and contact details are not returned; they are on Showcasia after free sign-in.

city.description: City name or slug. Live cities: Pune, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Gurugram, Noida, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Kochi.

type.description: Section: rent (Rent), premium-rent (Premium rent), buy (Buy), title-limited (Title-limited), commercial (Commercial), industrial (Industrial), coworking (Co-working).

locality.description: Part of a locality name, for example Baner.

property_type.description: Part of the property type, for example apartment (same as flat), villa, plot, office.

checked_only.description: Only listings whose identity, documents or presence Showcasia has checked.

tools.name: get_property_evidence
tools.description: For one listing id from search_properties: how far Showcasia has checked it (identity, documents, seen on a video call or visit) and on which date.
